title: Rental Vehicle Coordination Repair-Customer Discount: Amount of the Credit
content:
**Amount.** The repair-customer discount credit on a customer-pay Rental Vehicle Coordination rental tied to a network customer-pay repair is the class customer-pay discount percent of the time charge posted on the final invoice: the posted time charge multiplied by that percent and divided by one hundred, rounded to the cent once at the end. The credit names the rental's time charge and is booked on the rental.

## Inputs

| Input | Where it is read |
|---|---|
| Time charge posted on the final invoice | The customer's uncovered-days charge on the final invoice, in the rental's day and money history |
| Class customer-pay discount percent | The class rate schedule, for the class rented |

## Worked figure (hypothetical inputs)

An Intermediate Rental carries a time charge of 469.90 USD posted on its final invoice; the class customer-pay discount is 10 percent. The credit is 469.90 USD multiplied by 10 and divided by one hundred, 46.99 USD.

A Minivan Rental with a posted time charge of 343.94 USD at the same 10 percent gives 34.394 USD before rounding, and a credit of 34.39 USD once rounded to the cent at the end.

## Quick reference

| Posted time charge (hypothetical) | Discount percent | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| 200.00 USD | 10 | 20.00 USD |
| 229.00 USD | 10 | 22.90 USD |
| 515.87 USD | 10 | 51.59 USD (51.587 before rounding) |
